posts.trend: India’s Alcobev Industry Gears Up for Festive and Wedding Season as Premium Liquor Demand Rises
posts.context: Wedding bartenders spend twenty minutes smoking rosemary and pouring artisanal foam while older relatives just want whisky and tap water.
posts.angle: The wedding industry charges per guest for theatrical smoke and foam that nobody actually wants to drink.

landing_options.line: Your uncle asked for whisky with plain water and broke the theme.
You waited twenty minutes for smoky ice.
The glass has foam on top and regret at the bottom.
Half the drink was smoke. The other half was rosemary.

slides: The wedding invite says "Curated Craft Cocktail Experience."

It is a man lighting cinnamon on fire for 14 minutes.
He puts a sprig of grass on ice.
₹1,800 per guest for the bar package, and the tonic water is warm.
Your uncle asked for whisky with plain water and broke the theme.
posts.caption: Somebody in your family will always order "neat with two cubes" at a molecular mixology counter 🍸

tweet.setup: Wedding invites now promise a curated craft cocktail experience.
tweet.punch: You wait 18 minutes for a guy to burn a cinnamon stick over warm tonic.

comments.post: Curated mixology bars with smoked botanicals are the biggest wedding trend this season.

items.text: Bro I just wanted one drink before the baraat left
Waiting 20 minutes to be handed a glass full of rosemary leaves
My chachu asked for whisky soda and the bartender looked hurt
Five thousand rupees a plate and the ice melts before the smoke clears.

posts.rank_verdict: Tight and universally funny, though Slide 2 describes the bar in general terms instead of keeping the reader's own point of view consistent.
